title.value: Take All Menstrual Product-PFAS Out Now (T.A.M.P.O.N.) Act
title.provenance: SECTION 1. This act shall be known, and may be cited, as the Take All Menstrual Product-PFAS Out Now (T.A.M.P.O.N.) Act.

location.provenance: The California Constitution requires the state to reimburse local agencies and school districts for certain costs mandated by the state.

status.provenance: [ Approved by Governor  September 30, 2024. Filed with Secretary of State September 30, 2024. ]

pfas_definition.provenance: ÒPerfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substancesÓ or ÒPFASÓ means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: Existing law, beginning January 1, 2025, prohibits a person or entity from manufacturing, selling, delivering, holding, or offering for sale in commerce any cosmetic product that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), as defined.
